hook: Your brain uses mental accounting to mentally organize, evaluate, and track financial activities across 21 countries.

sections.voiceover: Your brain uses mental accounting to mentally organize, evaluate, and track financial activities across 21 countries.
b_roll: Close-up of a brain scan graphic with glowing currency symbols

sections.voiceover: Researchers at Columbia University's Mailman School of Public Health published findings on July 10, 2026. How do researchers know how your mind tracks cash?
Except mental accounting emerged four decades ago to explain how people evaluate financial activities.
The international study tested 21 countries to validate how people organize and track finances.
The Journal of Consumer Research confirms these mental accounting effects across 21 different countries.
